prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up portrait of a woman holding a magnifying glass up to her face, with the lens positioned directly over one of her eyes, dramatically enlarging and distorting the eye and surrounding features. The woman has straight brown hair with blunt bangs, and her visible eye is accentuated with bold, shimmering blue eyeshadow and dark eyeliner, creating a striking focal point. Her lips, slightly out of focus and partially visible at the bottom of the frame, are painted a soft red. The background is a smooth, pale blue gradient, lending a clean, modern feel to the composition. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the textures of her skin and makeup without harsh shadows. The overall style is crisp and contemporary, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and parts of her face outside the magnified area, drawing attention to the eye and creating a sense of curiosity and intrigue. The camera angle is straight-on, emphasizing the symmetry and intensity of the gaze, while the magnifying glass adds a playful, investigative quality to the image.
